AS INT64), CAST(NULL AS STRING) FROM `atrio_atrio_institucional`.`facebook_ads_adsinsights`), cap AS (SELECT ad_id AS cap_id, ANY_VALUE(COALESCE(NULLIF(body, ''), NULLIF(title, ''))) AS cap_leg FROM ga_channels.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT LOWER(sessionSource) AS src, LOWER(sessionMedium) AS med, SAFE_CAST(sessions AS FLOAT64) AS sessoes FROM `atrio_atrio_institucional`.`google_analytics_ga4_traffic_sources` WHERE PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date) >= COALESCE(CAST({{start}} AS DATE), DATE '2026-09-01') AND PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date) <= COALESCE(CAST({{end}} AS DATE), DATE '2026-12-31')) SELECT CASE WHEN src = '(direct)' THEN 'Direto' WHEN med = 'organic' THEN 'Busca orgânica' WHEN med = 'email' THEN 'E-mail' WHEN med = 'ai-assistant' THEN 'IA (ChatGPT etc.)' WHEN src IN ('ig', 'fb', 'an', 'facebook', 'meta') OR src LIKE 'meta |%' THEN 'Meta Ads' WHEN src LIKE 'linkedin%' AND med IN ('paid-social', 'paid', 'cpc') THEN 'LinkedIn Ads' WHEN src = 'youtube' OR med = 'paid_midia' THEN 'YouTube Ads' WHEN (src = 'google' AND med = 'cpc') OR src = 'googleads' THEN 'Google Ads (Search)' WHEN med = 'referral' THEN 'Referral' ELSE 'Outros' END AS canal, SUM(sessoes) AS sessoes FROM s GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

li_demo_funcao.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT * FROM `atrio_atrio_institucional`.`linkedin_follower_demographics` ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT CASE x.function WHEN 'urn:li:function:1' THEN 'Contabilidade' WHEN 'urn:li:function:2' THEN 'Administrativo' WHEN 'urn:li:function:3' THEN 'Arte e design' WHEN 'urn:li:function:4' THEN 'Desenvolvimento de negócios' WHEN 'urn:li:function:5' THEN 'Serviços sociais' WHEN 'urn:li:function:6' THEN 'Consultoria' WHEN 'urn:li:function:7' THEN 'Educação' WHEN 'urn:li:function:8' THEN 'Engenharia' WHEN 'urn:li:function:9' THEN 'Empreendedorismo' WHEN 'urn:li:function:10' THEN 'Finanças' WHEN 'urn:li:function:11' THEN 'Saúde' WHEN 'urn:li:function:12' THEN 'Recursos humanos' WHEN 'urn:li:function:13' THEN 'Tecnologia da informação' WHEN 'urn:li:function:14' THEN 'Jurídico' WHEN 'urn:li:function:15' THEN 'Marketing' WHEN 'urn:li:function:16' THEN 'Comunicação' WHEN 'urn:li:function:18' THEN 'Operações' WHEN 'urn:li:function:20' THEN 'Gestão de projetos' WHEN 'urn:li:function:21' THEN 'Compras' WHEN 'urn:li:function:23' THEN 'Imobiliário' WHEN 'urn:li:function:24' THEN 'Pesquisa' WHEN 'urn:li:function:25' THEN 'Vendas' WHEN 'urn:li:function:26' THEN 'Suporte' ELSE 'Outras funções' END AS rotulo, SUM(x.followerCounts.organicFollowerCount + x.followerCounts.paidFollowerCount) AS seguidores FROM d, UNNEST(d.followerCountsByFunction) x GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 8

li_demo_porte.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT * FROM `atrio_atrio_institucional`.`linkedin_follower_demographics` ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT CASE WHEN x.staffCountRange LIKE '%OR_MORE' THEN CONCAT(REGEXP_EXTRACT(x.staffCountRange, '[0-9]+'), '+') ELSE REPLACE(REPLACE(x.staffCountRange, 'SIZE_', ''), '_TO_', '–') END AS rotulo, SUM(x.followerCounts.organicFollowerCount + x.followerCounts.paidFollowerCount) AS seguidores FROM d, UNNEST(d.followerCountsByStaffCountRange) x GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY MIN(CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(x.staffCountRange, '[0-9]+') AS INT64))

li_demo_senioridade.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT * FROM `atrio_atrio_institucional`.`linkedin_follower_demographics` ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT CASE x.seniority WHEN 'urn:li:seniority:1' THEN 'Não remunerado' WHEN 'urn:li:seniority:2' THEN 'Estágio/treinamento' WHEN 'urn:li:seniority:3' THEN 'Júnior' WHEN 'urn:li:seniority:4' THEN 'Sênior' WHEN 'urn:li:seniority:5' THEN 'Gerente' WHEN 'urn:li:seniority:6' THEN 'Diretor' WHEN 'urn:li:seniority:7' THEN 'VP' WHEN 'urn:li:seniority:8' THEN 'Sócio' WHEN 'urn:li:seniority:9' THEN 'C-level' WHEN 'urn:li:seniority:10' THEN 'Proprietário' ELSE 'Outros' END AS rotulo, SUM(x.followerCounts.organicFollowerCount + x.followerCounts.paidFollowerCount) AS seguidores FROM d, UNNEST(d.followerCountsBySeniority) x GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

li_demo_setor.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT * FROM `atrio_atrio_institucional`.`linkedin_follower_demographics` ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT CASE x.industry WHEN 'urn:li:industry:31' THEN 'Hotelaria e hospitalidade' WHEN 'urn:li:industry:30' THEN 'Turismo e lazer' WHEN 'urn:li:industry:32' THEN 'Restaurantes' WHEN 'urn:li:industry:34' THEN 'Alimentos e bebidas' WHEN 'urn:li:industry:96' THEN 'TI e consultoria de TI' WHEN 'urn:li:industry:27' THEN 'Varejo' WHEN 'urn:li:industry:43' THEN 'Serviços financeiros' WHEN 'urn:li:industry:44' THEN 'Imobiliário' WHEN 'urn:li:industry:11' THEN 'Consultoria empresarial' ELSE 'Outros setores' END AS rotulo, SUM(x.followerCounts.organicFollowerCount + x.followerCounts.paidFollowerCount) AS seguidores FROM d, UNNEST(d.followerCountsByIndustry) x GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 8

li_followers_daily.sql: SELECT CAST(DATE(date) AS STRING) AS dia, 'Orgânico' AS serie, followerGains.organicFollowerGain AS valor FROM `atrio_atrio_institucional`.`linkedin_daily_follower_statistics` WHERE DATE(date) >= COALESCE(CAST({{start}} AS DATE), DATE '2026-09-01') AND DATE(date) <= COALESCE(CAST({{end}} AS DATE), DATE '2026-12-31') UNION ALL SELECT CAST(DATE(date) AS STRING), 'Pago', followerGains.paidFollowerGain FROM `atrio_atrio_institucional`.`linkedin_daily_follower_statistics` WHERE DATE(date) >= COALESCE(CAST({{start}} AS DATE), DATE '2026-09-01') AND DATE(date) <= COALESCE(CAST({{end}} AS DATE), DATE '2026-12-31') ORDER BY 1, 2

li_top_posts.sql: SELECT postId AS chave, CAST(DATE(TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(postLastModifiedAt)) AS STRING) AS data_post, totalShareStatistics.impressionCount AS impressoes, totalShareStatistics.uniqueImpressionsCount AS alcance, totalShareStatistics.clickCount AS cliques, totalShareStatistics.likeCount AS curtidas, totalShareStatistics.commentCount AS comentarios, totalShareStatistics.shareCount AS compartilhamentos, ROUND(totalShareStatistics.engagement, 4) AS engajamento FROM `atrio_atrio_institucional`.`linkedin_post_statistics` WHERE DATE(TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(postLastModifiedAt)) >= COALESCE(CAST({{start}} AS DATE), DATE '2026-09-01') AND DATE(TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(postLastModifiedAt)) <= COALESCE(CAST({{end}} AS DATE), DATE '2026-12-31') ORDER BY impressoes DESC LIMIT 10

li_totals.sql: SELECT SUM(totalShareStatistics.impressionCount) AS impressoes, SUM(totalShareStatistics.uniqueImpressionsCount) AS alcance_soma_diaria, SUM(totalShareStatistics.clickCount) AS cliques, SUM(totalShareStatistics.likeCount) + SUM(totalShareStatistics.commentCount) + SUM(totalShareStatistics.shareCount) AS interacoes, ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(totalShareStatistics.clickCount) + SUM(totalShareStatistics.likeCount) + SUM(totalShareStatistics.commentCount) + SUM(totalShareStatistics.shareCount), SUM(totalShareStatistics.impressionCount)), 4) AS taxa_engajamento, ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(totalShareStatistics.clickCount), SUM(totalShareStatistics.impressionCount)), 4) AS ctr FROM `atrio_atrio_institucional`.`linkedin_daily_share_statistics` WHERE DATE(date) >= COALESCE(CAST({{start}} AS DATE), DATE '2026-09-01') AND DATE(date) <= COALESCE(CAST({{end}} AS DATE), DATE '2026-12-31')

spend_daily.sql: WITH ads AS (SELECT 'LinkedIn Ads' AS plataforma, a.date AS dia, c.name AS campanha, CAST(a.costInLocalCurrency AS FLOAT64) AS v_gasto, a.impressions AS v_imp, a.clicks AS v_clk, COALESCE(a.externalWebsitePostClickConversions, 0) + COALESCE(a.externalWebsitePostViewConversions, 0) AS v_conv, CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS v_reach FROM `atrio_atrio_institucional`.`linkedin_ads_campaign_analytics` a LEFT JOIN `atrio_atrio_institucional`.`linkedin_ads_campaigns` c ON a.campaign_id = c.id UNION ALL SELECT 'Google Ads', DATE(date), campaign_name, metrics_cost_micros / 1e6, metrics_impressions, metrics_clicks, CAST(ROUND(metrics_conversions) AS INT64), CAST(NULL AS INT64) FROM `atrio_atrio_institucional`.`google_ads_campaign_performance` UNION ALL SELECT 'Meta Ads', SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', SUBSTR(date_start, 1, 10)), campaign_name, SAFE_CAST(spend AS FLOAT64), SAFE_CAST(impressions AS INT64), SAFE_CAST(inline_link_clicks AS INT64), CAST(ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(SAFE_CAST(x.value AS FLOAT64)) FROM UNNEST(actions) x WHERE LOWER(x.action_type) LIKE '%lead%'), 0)) AS INT64), SAFE_CAST(reach AS INT64) FROM `atrio_atrio_institucional`.`facebook_ads_adsinsights`) SELECT CAST(dia AS STRING) AS dia, plataforma, ROUND(SUM(v_gasto), 2) AS gasto FROM ads WHERE dia >= COALESCE(CAST({{start}} AS DATE), DATE '2026-09-01') AND dia <= COALESCE(CAST({{end}} AS DATE), DATE '2026-12-31') AND (CAST({{platform}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR plataforma = CAST({{platform}} AS STRING)) AND (CAST({{campaign}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR campanha = CAST({{campaign}} AS STRING)) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
